current_bottleneck: Local factor conditioning is mechanically safe and improves conditionality, but the full-core 555a fine-tune does not solve deployability because regime/cell under-inclusion remains the blocker and worsened versus 510a under the lower-only risk audit.
last_result_summary: 555a added local-factor histories from vol_surface_with_ret.npz to the 510a empirical-normal-score core and fine-tuned all parameters for 4 epochs on the 441 pre-validation windows. It scored 8/11, failing coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. Conditionality improved to 6.20% MAE reduction, cointegration and pathwise realism passed, but regime lower-only worst cell was 0.385 versus 510a's 0.538, so it is not more risk-manager deployable.
next_step_recommendation: Analyze the remaining regime under-inclusion directly. The next clean move should target future IV-level/regime occupancy geometry, not another factor side-channel or post-hoc factor score calibration.
current_best_note: 392a, 510a, and 555a all score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 555a is useful evidence for local factor conditioning but is not a new best because its risk-readiness regime worst cell is 0.385 versus 510a's 0.538.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
